>>> help build
build commands:
  build preview                   Trigger async preview build
  build start [tiled]             Execute a full build
  build status                    Show build status and progress
  build stop                      Cancel current build or preview

<<<
>>> help export
export commands:
  export all                      Export all File Output devices (Pro)
  export list                     List configured File Output devices (Pro)

<<<
>>> help debug
debug commands:
  debug devicetiming [device]     Show where each device's build time goes
  debug get <key>                 Get a debug variable
  debug list [filter]             List debug variables
  debug pclear                    Clear all debug output packets
  debug previewtiming [device|reset]  Inspect or reset interactive preview res scaling
  debug reassign                  Reassign all device IDs in the world
  debug remove <name>             Remove a stored debug packet
  debug revert                    Reset all debug variables to defaults
  debug set <key> <value>         Set a debug variable
  debug style <reload|clear>      Reload or clear the app-wide stylesheet
  debug unset <key>               Clear a debug variable
  debug view [name]               Open the debug packet viewer
  debug viewtargets               Show the current view targets and what the previewer got

<<<
>>> help snapshot
snapshot commands:
  snapshot create <name>          Create a snapshot of the current state
  snapshot delete <name|#index>   Delete a snapshot
  snapshot list                   List all snapshots
  snapshot restore <name|#index>  Restore project from a snapshot

<<<
>>> help system
system commands:
  system heal [apply]             Diagnose and fix stale settings
  system info                     Show system info
  system purge                    Purge all build results
  system quit [force]             Exit World Machine

<<<
>>> help group
group commands:
  group build <name|#index>       Build all devices in a group
  group disable <name|#index>     Disable all devices in a group
  group enable <name|#index>      Enable all devices in a group
  group list [filter]             List all groups

<<<
